societies.name: Scythe (Humanity under the Thunderhead)
societies.society: The early Thunderhead-administered human provision system

scope.continuity: Shusterman Arc of a Scythe book continuity
scope.period: Scythe and the early Thunderhead order before the later global rupture
scope.population: Living human residents of the Thunderhead-administered society
exclusions: The independent scythedom treated as AI-controlled
Later Silence and final settlement assigned the early rules
All formally employed people assumed to do necessary productive work

societies.description:
The Thunderhead supplies the foundation of a society without ordinary hunger or poverty. Shusterman connects its economy with a basic income paid for existence, rather than a wage earned through necessary labor. Citizens can still hold jobs, and some jobs are deliberately retained to give people purpose even though machines could perform them. The strong guarantee estimate therefore concerns material access; it does not mean formal employment has vanished.

Decisive administration belongs to the independent AI, so productive control lies near the autonomous end of the axis. The scythedom is a significant exception: human scythes control irreversible killing beyond the Thunderhead’s authority. Their power qualifies security and prevents a claim of complete machine control over every human outcome. The employment policy has a zero-variant feature, but the main record remains an AI-provision regime because support is already detached from necessary wages. Neither cosmetic jobs nor the absence of poverty provides a census of useful artistic, care or civic work. The nonworking share remains unresolved, and later disruptions require a separate scope.

guarantees.basis: Technological provision removes ordinary hunger and poverty; independent scythe killing qualifies broader personal security.

control.basis: The Thunderhead independently runs almost everything while scythes retain a specific protected jurisdiction.

nonworking.basis: The author describes dispensable employment, but formal jobs and useful chosen activities are not a population-wide nonworking count.

evidence.claim: Basic-income support coexists with jobs retained for purpose despite machine capacity.
AI technological administration eliminates ordinary material deprivation but does not control the scythedom.

uncertainties: Artificial job retention overlaps the zero-variant spectrum; no second society is added solely to count that feature again.
The post-work classification follows material support independent of necessary wages, while the employment-preservation feature is recorded separately.
The nonworking rate remains unresolved and does not equate cosmetic employment with useful production.

review.method: Second pass against the gathered passages, including explicit uncertainty; no independent reviewer

employment_preservation.basis: The author explicitly describes jobs maintained for purpose despite available machine substitution, alongside existence-based income.

review_notes: Ten fast decisions and one directly author-supported AI-provision record; no novels or long source recoveries read.

The supplied article’s zero-variant passage was reread to check overlap. Scythe retains artificial employment but has already detached material support from necessary wages; both facts are recorded without duplicate inflation.
The optional employment_preservation annotation records this hybrid feature without converting one system into two societies.
Shusterman’s interview supplies strong institutional evidence, but not a work census. Later rupture and final outcomes remain outside the record.
